text:
[Council File 26-1447]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER (CAO) and RESOLUTION relative to the appointment of Aurora Abracia as a new Director of the Municipal Improvement Corporation of Los Angeles (MICLA) Board of Directors.
Recommendation for Council action:
ADOPT the accompanying RESOLUTION, included as Attachment A of the CAO report dated October 9, 2026, attached to the Council file, approving Aurora Abracia as a new Director of the MICLA to fill an existing vacancy of the Board of Directors of MICLA; and, approving and authorizing any actions with respect thereto.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the CAO. The Chief Legislative Analyst has not completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
(Budget and Finance Committee waived consideration of the above matter.)
TIME LIMIT FILE - NOVEMBER 23, 2026 (LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - NOVEMBER 20, 2026)
